question.question: Give the full combat resolution order, including simultaneous effect priority, whether effects are optional, other after-combat game effects and played-card destinations.

fixed_key.expected_answer: Resolve immediately effects then during-combat effects then combat damage/result then after-combat card effects then other after-combat game effects; At any same timing defender effect first; Card effects mandatory unless specified otherwise; Finally put played cards in respective face-up discard piles
required_facts: Resolve immediately effects then during-combat effects then combat damage/result then after-combat card effects then other after-combat game effects
At any same timing defender effect first
Card effects mandatory unless specified otherwise
Finally put played cards in respective face-up discard piles

frozen_scope.asked_clauses: Give the full combat resolution order, including simultaneous effect priority, whether effects are optional, other after-combat game effects and played-card destinations.
required_answer_facts: Resolve immediately effects then during-combat effects then combat damage/result then after-combat card effects then other after-combat game effects
At any same timing defender effect first

Finally put played cards in respective face-up discard piles

clauses: Full order of card-effect timing, damage resolution, other after-combat effects, and discard.
Priority when both players have an effect at the same timing.
Whether effects are optional.
a.answer: Resolve immediately effects, then during-combat effects, determine and apply combat damage, resolve after-combat card effects, resolve other after-combat game effects, then put all played cards in their owners’ discard piles. For effects sharing a timing, defender resolves first. Effects are mandatory unless they say otherwise.

evidence.text:
1. Resolve **IMMEDIATELY** card effects.
2. Resolve **DURING COMBAT** card effects.
3. Determine combat result: defender takes attack value minus defense value, to a minimum of zero. If no defense card, take the attack value. Reduce the defending fighter’s health by the damage dealt. Defense does not itself deal return damage.
4. Resolve **AFTER COMBAT card effects**. A defeated fighter’s played card still resolves its after-combat effects **unless the game has already ended**.
5. Resolve other after-combat game effects, such as a hero’s special ability.
6. Finally place all played cards in their respective discard piles.

**Whenever effects share a timing, the defender’s effect resolves first.** Card effects are **mandatory unless they say otherwise** (for example “may”); this can harm your own fighters. Complete them in the printed order. A card whose effects are canceled keeps its printed combat value; the canceled effects do not resolve.
